description: This file contains unit tests for the MacGatewayChatTransport module, specifically testing the mapping of push events to transport events for different scenarios such as health, tick, chat, and sequence gaps.

classes.name: MacGatewayChatTransportMappingTests
classes.description: Test suite containing multiple test cases for mapping push events to transport events.

methods.name: `snapshot maps to health`
methods.description: Tests that a snapshot event maps correctly to a health transport event.

methods.name: `health event maps to health`
methods.description: Tests that a health event is correctly mapped to a health transport event.

methods.name: `tick event maps to tick`
methods.description: Tests that a tick event is correctly mapped to a tick transport event.

methods.name: `chat event maps to chat`
methods.description: Tests that a chat event is correctly mapped to a chat transport event with the expected fields.

methods.name: `unknown event maps to nil`
methods.description: Tests that an unknown event type results in a nil mapping.

methods.name: `seq gap maps to seq gap`
methods.description: Tests that a sequence gap event maps correctly to a seqGap transport event.
